items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: I did a sketch with him. I played my hit things.

ctx.x: It might sound like that but I don't do it that way every time. Now, I have to learn it over like the record because he says, "You've got to do this just like the record because I've got steps going with it." And he featured me all the way through. Not like they used to throw you out there and do two numbers and that's all. I did a sketch with him. I played my hit things. And then I was in the "St. James Infirmary." "St. James Infirmary," was the big number of the show, and he was standing behind me, singing, and…
